root_text:
DO NOT PANIC
WHAT IS #HMPV 
Human metapneumovirus (#hmpvvirus ) is not new and is found during winters in India

TRANSMISSION - Through coughs or sneezes or through hands or surfaces contaminated with the virus

PEOPLE AT RISK - Child below
